findings.title: Materials' 50-point lens gap is a margin-recovery bet
findings.body: Materials sits at the 41st percentile forward but 91st trailing, with 119 percent implied earnings growth. The market is pricing a full earnings recovery that has not yet shown up in reported results.

findings.title: Consumer Staples' percentile collapse hides a rich trailing multiple
findings.body: Staples fell 15 points in forward percentile over the month to the 28th, yet its trailing P/E is at the 84th percentile. The forward lens is discounting a 44 percent earnings jump that the trailing numbers have not confirmed.

findings.title: Communication Services is the cheapest it has been in five years
findings.body: At the 1st forward percentile, Communication Services is at the very bottom of its five-year range, with a 25-point gap toward trailing richness. The market is underwriting 55 percent earnings growth, a steep bet that has not yet materialized.
